title: Cult
desc: Madhava and Geetha's village romance ends abruptly when they part ways for college in different cities. However, Madhava finds solace and new love with Ithi, who helps mend his broken heart.

title: Chikkejamanru
desc: A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.

title: Avatara Purusha
desc: A junior artist named Anila is roped into a plan to bring together a broken family. However, he stumbles upon a powerful secret of theirs that involves black magic and the supernatural.

title: Ayogya
desc: Siddhe Gowda, an unemployed young man, decides to run against Bachche Gowda, the village head, in the local election. He also begins to fall in love with Nandini, the daughter of a marriage broker.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.
